focus_area_title: Determine If Your Team Has Issues with Unfair Pay
content_text_body:
People who do not feel fairly rewarded in their jobs may not be fully engaged or satisfied with their roles. The goal is to see if your team members have a concern about pay or if there are other non-compensation related issues.

### Request feedback from your team

For the following questions, ask your team members to write down and share their answers with you anonymously. 

> Is my pay I competitive and does it match the industry average for my responsibilities and level? 

> Am I paid the same as peers with similar responsibilities and in the same role as me?  

> Do I get sufficient recognition, any non-monetary acknowledgement for my results, performance and dedication to my job, or for qualities that make me a special team member?

### Look for a common sentiment or issue

If the common issue is about pay, it should not be taken lightly. It can seriously undermine their motivation and effort in their everyday responsibilities. 

If the issues on your team are with the fairness of pay within your team or company, see further actions below to take for how to [Resolve Internal Pay Equity Issues](Glint_Rewards_Resolve_Internal_Pay_Equity_Issues).

If the common concern is with how pay compares for similar role on the open job market, see further actions below to [Resolve Competitive Compensation Issues](Glint_Rewards_Resolve_Competitive_Compensation_Issues).
